title: Everyday Phrases — Packing for a Trip
scene_zh: 打包行李 · 情境對話
title_quote: Our trip starts this weekend, right?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🧳 實用打包行李必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Packing for a Trip
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用打包行李情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），一家人一起收拾行李箱，從查天氣列清單到壓箱貼名牌，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Packing for a Trip phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). A family packs suitcases together, from checking the weather and making a list to sitting the case shut and hanging the name tag. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our trip starts this weekend, right?
dialogue.zh: 我們這週末就出發了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we fly Saturday morning.
dialogue.zh: 對，我們週六早上搭飛機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you look at the weather there?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju lʊk æt ðə ˈwɛðər ðɛr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will be cool in the mornings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɪl bi kʊl ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it rain during our stay?
dialogue.zh: 我們在那邊會遇到下雨嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe Sunday, so bring an umbrella.
dialogue.zh: 週日可能下，所以帶把傘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we make a packing list first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi meɪk ə ˈpækɪŋ lɪst fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 我們先列一張打包清單好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, grab a pen and paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə, ɡræb ə pɛn ænd ˈpeɪpər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many days are we gone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five days, so plan for five.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need warm jackets there?
dialogue.zh: 那邊需要保暖的外套嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nights get cold after sunset.
dialogue.zh: 要，太陽下山後夜晚很冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many shirts should I pack?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three shirts are enough for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can wear one shirt twice.
dialogue.zh: 一件襯衫我可以穿兩天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here, space is limited.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，行李箱空間有限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want your new dress?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll wear it to dinner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need your warm pajamas?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One set is fine, maybe two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we ask the kids to help?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi æsk ðə kɪdz tə hɛlp?/
dialogue.zh: 要叫孩子一起來幫忙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let's pack with them now.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們現在就跟他們一起收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you ask Emma about her bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju æsk ˈɛmə əˈbaʊt hɜr bæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 你有跟艾瑪說她的包包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She wants to pack it herself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fine, we have time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But not much, the taxi comes early.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt nɑt mʌtʃ, ðə ˈtæksi kʌmz ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: 也是，可時間不多，計程車很早就來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is our big blue suitcase still around?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz aʊər bɪɡ blu ˈsutˌkeɪs stɪl əˈraʊnd?/
dialogue.zh: 我們那個藍色大行李箱還在吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the closet, slightly broken.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the zipper still work?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but one wheel is loose.
dialogue.zh: 好用，但有一個輪子鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we take the hard shell one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi teɪk ðə hɑrd ʃɛl wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們改帶硬殼那個好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this one holds more things.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you put the luggage scale?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ju pʊt ðə ˈlʌɡɪdʒ skeɪl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the kitchen drawer, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need it to weigh our bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid ɪt tə weɪ aʊər bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 我們要用它秤行李重量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, heavy bags cost extra.
dialogue.zh: 對，超重行李要額外加錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much can one bag weigh?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-three kilos, so be careful.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's write shoes on the list.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, they take up the most room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðeɪ teɪk ʌp ðə moʊst rum./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What shoes do you want to bring?
dialogue.phonetic: /wət ʃuz du ju wɔnt tə brɪŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My white sneakers and boots.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the kids need new rain boots?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə kɪdz nid nu reɪn buts?/
dialogue.zh: 孩子們需要新的雨鞋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, their old ones are tiny.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you pack your sunglasses?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, I'll grab mine now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add hats to our list, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call, the sun is strong there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kɔl, ðə sʌn ɪz strɔŋ ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 說得好，那邊日照很強烈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we keeping the list on paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /ər wi ˈkipɪŋ ðə lɪst ɑn ˈpeɪpər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just take a photo of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, dʒʌst teɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不用，用手機拍一張就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many towels do we need?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hotel has towels, I checked.
dialogue.zh: 飯店有提供毛巾，我查過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then skip towels, save the space.
dialogue.zh: 那就別帶毛巾，省下空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the room fits other things.
dialogue.zh: 對，那些位子能放別的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need your workout clothes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I plan to run each morning.
dialogue.zh: 我打算每天早上去跑步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pack the black shorts and socks.
dialogue.zh: 把黑色短褲和襪子收進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five pairs of socks is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you count your underwear?
dialogue.zh: 你有數要帶幾件內衣褲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six pairs, plus a spare or two.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks pɛrz, plʌs ə spɛr ɔr tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't forget your swimsuit, okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hotel pool is heated, right?
dialogue.zh: 飯店的泳池是溫水的吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is, so bring your suit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's in my drawer, I'll fetch it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɪn maɪ drɔr, aɪl fɛtʃ ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we pack snacks for the kids?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi pæk snæks fər ðə kɪdz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, small bags of crackers work.
dialogue.zh: 要，小包裝的蘇打餅乾就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write down juice boxes, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids get thirsty on the road.
dialogue.zh: 孩子們在路上容易口乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we bringing any board games?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small game for rainy nights.
dialogue.zh: 帶一個小遊戲應付雨夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about books for the flight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each kid can bring one book.
dialogue.zh: 每個孩子可以帶一本書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want your pillow from home?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɔnt jʊr ˈpɪloʊ frʌm hoʊm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only for the long ride there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check what the hotel gives.
dialogue.zh: 我們查查飯店提供什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just soap, nothing else.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we bring our own shampoo.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the travel-size bottles.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your gray coat clean?
dialogue.zh: 你的灰色外套是乾淨的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wore it once, it's still fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɔr ɪt wʌns, ɪts stɪl frɛʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you fold the clothes already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll roll them instead of folding.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rolling saves so much room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your mother taught me that trick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you book our taxi yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, for six-thirty tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you fill the water bottles?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty for now, fill at the airport.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmpˌti fər naʊ, fɪl æt ði ˈɛrˌpɔrt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we bringing the cooler bag?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, for snacks on day one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How soon should we leave home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours early, to be safe.
dialogue.zh: 提早兩個小時，穩妥一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That means waking up at five-thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ˈweɪkɪŋ ʌp æt faɪv ˈθɜrti./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we sleep early tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mark 'check passport dates' here.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡寫下「查護照效期」。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thinking, I'll look tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your passport in the safe?
dialogue.zh: 你的護照放在保險箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's in my desk drawer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we pack in the bedroom?
dialogue.zh: 我們到臥室去收拾好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'll clear the bed first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's spread the clothes on the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts sprɛd ðə kloʊðz ɑn ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我們把衣服鋪在床上吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, yours go on the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sort the shirts from the pants.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll match outfits for each day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That gray sweater goes with everything.
dialogue.zh: 那件灰毛衣什麼都能搭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it, it packs very flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two pairs of jeans enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One is plenty, jeans last long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put all the socks in one bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɔl ðə sɑks ɪn wʌn bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 襪子全部裝進一個袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the clean grocery sack.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put shoes in plastic bags, okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then mud stays off clothes.
dialogue.zh: 好，這樣就不會弄髒衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which shoes go at the bottom?
dialogue.zh: 哪些鞋子放在行李箱底層？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The boots, near the wheels.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now roll the T-shirts tightly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like little rolls, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, rolls fit into tiny gaps.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This saves half my suitcase.
dialogue.zh: 這樣能省下一半行李箱空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should belts wrap around the edge?
dialogue.zh: 皮帶要圍在箱子邊緣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great idea, thread them through.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need collar stays?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skip them, I'll hang shirts fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fold the sweater, don't roll it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why? Does rolling stretch it?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？捲會把它拉鬆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the neck gets loose.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, I'll fold mine then.
dialogue.zh: 知道了，那我那件就摺起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are Emma's little hair clips?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In her pink box by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn hɜr pɪŋk bɑks baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 在門邊她的粉紅盒子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her dress goes in the garment bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr drɛs ɡoʊz ɪn ðə ˈɡɑrmənt bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 她的洋裝放進防塵衣袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hangs in the closet already.
dialogue.zh: 那個袋子已經掛在衣櫃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need an extra hanger?
dialogue.zh: 我們需要多餘的衣架嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The closet has two spare ones.
dialogue.zh: 衣櫃裡還有兩個空衣架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close the case halfway for now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I still need to add things.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, aɪ stɪl nid tə æd θɪŋz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is my toiletry pouch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the sink, with your razor.
dialogue.zh: 在洗手台上，還有你的刮鬍刀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you clean the toothbrush cup?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's drying on a towel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The toothpaste is almost empty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then buy a new tube there.
dialogue.zh: 那到了那邊買一條新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add floss and mouthwash, too.
dialogue.zh: 牙線和漱口水也加進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only travel sizes fit the pouch.
dialogue.zh: 只有小包裝的塞得進洗漱包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deodorant goes in the side pocket.
dialogue.zh: 止汗劑放進側面的口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And sunscreen on top, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have enough band-aids?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I bought a fresh box Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pack the first aid kit, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sits by the medicine shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who takes the kids' fever medicine?
dialogue.zh: 孩子的退燒藥誰負責帶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll keep it in my small bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl kip ɪt ɪn maɪ smɔl bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我會把它放在我的小包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring your stomach pills, just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ jʊr ˈstʌmək pɪlz, dʒʌst ɪn keɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And Emma's allergy tablets.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you check the expiration dates?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All good, nothing expired.
dialogue.zh: 都沒問題，沒有任何過期藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep medicine away from heat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So not in the parked car.
dialogue.zh: 那就別留在停著的車裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't forget lip balm and lotion.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dry air there cracks lips.
dialogue.zh: 那邊空氣乾，嘴唇容易裂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the nail clipper?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the scissors, on the shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scissors must go in checked bags.
dialogue.zh: 剪刀一定要放託運行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll move the clipper over, too.
dialogue.zh: 指甲剪我也一併移過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Comb or brush for the kids?
dialogue.zh: 孩子要帶梳子還是刷子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A brush is faster, take it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we pack some baby wipes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, kids get sticky fast.
dialogue.zh: 要帶，孩子們一下子就弄得黏黏的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep a bag for dirty clothes.
dialogue.zh: 預留一個袋子裝髒衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have two big ones ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we buy wrinkle spray?
dialogue.zh: 我們要不要買防皺噴霧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bathroom steam fixes it instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want the travel iron?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we're going there to relax.
dialogue.zh: 不帶，我們是去那邊放鬆的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, fewer things to carry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My back already hurts today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the luggage tag holder?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the drawer with the maps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need an empty backpack?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, for souvenirs on the way back.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, fər ˈsuvəˌnɛrz ɑn ðə weɪ bæk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How full is the suitcase now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half done, still socks to roll.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't force the zipper.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll open it back up some.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we label both bags now?
dialogue.zh: 我們現在幫行李貼標籤？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Later, once everything is inside.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，等都收進去再貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you pack Emma's stuffed bear?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She sleeps with it — check her bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi slips wɪð ɪt tʃɛk hɜr bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 她抱著睡覺，去看看她床上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, under her blanket.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quick, before she notices.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we bring our own pillowcases?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need, the hotel has them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Earplugs for a noisy hall?
dialogue.zh: 走廊難免吵，要帶耳塞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two pairs, they're tiny.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An eye mask helps me sleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pack yours with the pajamas.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the shoes boxed or loose?
dialogue.zh: 鞋子是用盒子裝還是直接放？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose — the box wastes room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't forget our room slippers.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours wait by the front door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, clothes are nearly done.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pouch is already stuffed.
dialogue.zh: 洗漱包倒是已經塞滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you charge all the phones?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is full, Emma's is low.
dialogue.zh: 我的滿了，艾瑪的還偏低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Charge the power bank now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It takes three hours, plug it in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt teɪks θri aʊərz, plʌɡ ɪt ɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many cables do we need?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three, plus one spare, just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri, plʌs wʌn spɛr, dʒʌst ɪn keɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the cables tangled again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use twist ties, they stay neat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one is the laptop charger?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The thick gray one, top drawer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring the camera and its card.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the small tripod for photos.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need an extension cord?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, hotel outlets are never enough.
dialogue.zh: 要，飯店插座總是不夠用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need plug adapters, remember?
dialogue.zh: 我們要用轉接頭，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, their outlets are different.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many adapters should we grab?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, one for each of us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A universal one fits many countries.
dialogue.zh: 萬用款可以適合很多國家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then that solves the whole problem.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you keep the passports?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the zipped pouch inside my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə zɪpt paʊtʃ ɪnˈsaɪd maɪ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 在我包裡那個拉鏈夾袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wallets stay in our small bags, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɑləts steɪ ɪn aʊər smɔl bæɡz, raɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, never in checked luggage.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you copy the tickets and IDs?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju ˈkɑpi ðə ˈtɪkəts ænd ˈaɪˌdiz?/
dialogue.zh: 機票和證件你有備份嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Photos on phones, plus one print.
dialogue.zh: 手機裡存照片，再列印一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the cash in two places.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, some deep in the backpack.
dialogue.zh: 好，一部分塞在背包深處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the kids need small wallets?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so they learn to pay.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Extra batteries for the flash?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They recharge, no extras needed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put fragile things in the middle.
dialogue.zh: 易碎品放在行李箱中間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clothes cushion them nicely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Laptop in the big bag or small?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlæpˌtɑp ɪn ðə bɪɡ bæɡ ɔr smɔl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My bag, put it on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much storage is left?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plenty, I deleted old clips.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the kids have their headphones?
dialogue.zh: 孩子們有各自的耳機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the blue pair from last year.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə blu pɛr frʌm læst jɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weigh the big suitcase, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows twenty-six kilos.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's three kilos over the limit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, what can we remove?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take out the spare sweater.
dialogue.zh: 把那件備用毛衣拿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But nights get cold there!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then wear it, problem solved.
dialogue.zh: 那就穿在身上，問題解決了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever — my boots weigh a ton.
dialogue.zh: 真聰明，我那雙靴子可重了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that bring us under limit?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, twenty-two point nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still room for the wine glasses?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No more heavy items, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leave the guidebook at home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have it on our phones.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the umbrella in the small bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ði ʌmˈbrɛlə ɪn ðə smɔl bæɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It won't fit, too long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the suitcase must hold it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: As long as we stay under weight.
dialogue.phonetic: /əz lɔŋ æz wi steɪ ˈʌndər weɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Idea — wear the jacket at check-in.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪˈdiə, wɛr ðə ˈdʒækət æt tʃɛk ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 想到一點：報到時穿上外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, big pockets fit small items.
dialogue.zh: 對，大口袋還能塞小東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move the charger to my bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, I'll carry the cables.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spare batteries go in your pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tape the ends, that's safer.
dialogue.zh: 把兩端貼上膠帶更安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a lock on the bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid ə lɑk ɑn ðə bæɡ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a TSA-approved kind.
dialogue.zh: 要，用海關認證的那種鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Print the hotel address, just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɪnt ðə hoʊˈtɛl əˈdrɛs, dʒʌst ɪn keɪs./
dialogue.zh: 列印飯店地址以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our phones may die on arrival.
dialogue.zh: 到了當地手機可能沒電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you put the boarding passes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ju pʊt ðə ˈbɔrdɪŋ ˈpæsɪz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saved on both phones already.
dialogue.zh: 已經存在兩支手機裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also keep paper copies, safer.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll print them tonight.
dialogue.zh: 好，我今晚就把它們印出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My carry-on feels oddly heavy.
dialogue.zh: 我的隨身行李重得奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What did you hide in there?
dialogue.zh: 你偷偷塞了什麼在裡面？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing, maybe all the books.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me hold it — wow, heavy!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we split some items out?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the charger goes to you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the power bank fully charged?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green light — ready to go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep receipts in one envelope.
dialogue.zh: 收據統一放進一個信封。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I'll add the hotel ones.
dialogue.zh: 好，我把住飯店的也放進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you screenshot the maps?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, offline maps are installed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many bags are we carrying?
dialogue.zh: 我們一共要帶幾件行李？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two checked, four for our hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kids can carry their own bags.
dialogue.zh: 孩子們可以背自己的包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small ones, and light ones too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The scale says twenty-four.
dialogue.zh: 秤子上顯示二十四公斤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One over, take out a book.
dialogue.zh: 還超一公斤，拿一本書出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Emma will miss that storybook.
dialogue.zh: 艾瑪會想念那本故事書的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it on video calls instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you test the video calls yet?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju tɛst ðə ˈvɪdioʊ kɔːlz jɛt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight with Grandma, all set.
dialogue.zh: 今晚跟奶奶試過，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's my other earphone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Between the seat cushions, found it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything electronic is packed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost — one cable is missing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check under the sofa cushions.
dialogue.zh: 去沙發坐墊下面找找看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, here by the lamp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The zipper won't close, help me!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push the clothes down first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's still one inch open.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit on it, I'll pull hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm sitting — go, pull it!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slowly... it's moving now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost there, don't stop!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Click! We did it!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That case fought us hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time, a bigger one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you put the name tag on?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju pʊt ðə neɪm tæɡ ɑn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, whose phone number?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write mine, I travel more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it hangs on the handle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tie a red ribbon on ours.
dialogue.zh: 在我們行李上綁條紅緞帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever, easy to spot outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we must walk it downstairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful on the last step.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One heavy lift, then done.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My arms won't forgive you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who will watch the house?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Neighbor Lin waters the plants.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he get a spare key?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the trash day notes.
dialogue.zh: 給了，還有倒垃圾的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hall light is still on.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kitchen and bathroom, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we unplug the TV?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the coffee maker.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are all the windows closed?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll check once more, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kids are buckled in back.
dialogue.zh: 孩子們在後座繫好安全帶了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, keys, wallet — let's go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lock the door behind us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice, like your father says.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you hear the beep?
dialogue.zh: 你聽到鎖門的嗶聲了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loud and clear, we're set.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ride feels shorter somehow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Emma fell asleep at the gate.
dialogue.zh: 艾瑪在登機口就睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She slept through the whole flight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky kid, I'm exhausted.
dialogue.zh: 這小子真幸運，我累壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We parked the car downstairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, a hot shower.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keys, room two-oh-four.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's drop the bags fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait — where's my toiletry pouch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you see it at home?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last I had it by the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst aɪ hæd ɪt baɪ ðə sɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 最後一次它在洗手台邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, it stayed on the counter!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ, ɪt steɪd ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntər!/
dialogue.zh: 慘了，它還留在流理台上！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No toothbrush, no toothpaste.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The front desk sells kits.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A travel kit, finally!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five dollars, worth every cent.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My charger is missing, too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the blue jacket's pockets.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it! This trip teaches patience.
dialogue.zh: 找到了！這趟旅行真磨人耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time, we pack earlier.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kids already found the pool.
dialogue.zh: 孩子們已經找到泳池了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course they did, loudly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow we check the whole list.
dialogue.zh: 明天我們照清單全查一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kids' swimsuits! They're still at home!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɪdz ˈswɪmˌsuts! ðɛr stɪl æt hoʊm!/
dialogue.zh: 糟糕，孩子們的泳衣還留在家裡！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The gift shop sells them.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pricier, but what else?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We came here to relax, remember?
dialogue.zh: 我們是來放鬆的，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so no more worrying.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dinner smell from the lobby?
dialogue.zh: 大廳飄來晚餐的香味了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soup and bread downstairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let the kids eat first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then phones away for us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a long packing day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Longer than the trip itself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The beds here are so soft.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than ours at home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alarms off until morning, okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, sleep is the plan now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Goodnight, trip leader.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Goodnight, list maker.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The door is double-locked, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chain on, key inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Windows at home are closed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We checked twice, sleep now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hallway finally went quiet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kids crashed instantly.
dialogue.zh: 孩子們一下子就睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their bags wait by the door.
dialogue.zh: 他們的包包在門口等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, tomorrow needs them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One suitcase, still by the car.
dialogue.zh: 還有一個行李箱在車邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning — someone will fetch it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lazy answer, but perfect tonight.
dialogue.zh: 很偷懶的答案，今晚卻完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even the list can rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The trip starts fresh tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Packed, present, and peaceful.
dialogue.zh: 收好了，人到齊了，心也靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn off the lamp, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Click — dark and cozy now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you lock the car outside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beeped it from the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our phones glow, both at one percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊər foʊnz ɡloʊ, boʊθ æt wʌn pərˈsɛnt./
dialogue.zh: 我們的手機都亮著，只剩百分之一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow they'll live again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep now, dream of suitcases.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty ones, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good trip, good night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Packed and at peace.
